object.name: evi.trigholdgate~
object.digest: Trigger audio rate gates held for X ms in length
object.description: Audio rate trigger gates held for specified time, responding to trigger up, down or up/down, hold specified in ms including zero ms for single sample click.

inlets.description: Any audio rate trigger upwards or downwards can be detected depending on @trigger attribute.

outlets.description: Triggered gate of length specified by @hold attribute.

attributes.name: hold
attributes.description: Amount of time (set in ms) to 'hold' the (rectangular) triggered on/off gate for. zero = 1-sample click.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Respond to input trigger type: 0 = up/down, 1 = up only (default), 2 = down only.
